description_for_human: Map, debug, and review Copilot Studio agents from Microsoft 365 Copilot

functions.name: open_agent_review
functions.description: Start one review for one exact accessible agentName in the supplied environment or Copilot Studio Kit - Dev, including when the optional startReview flag is omitted. Return the acknowledged job ID for the stepper. An unclear, missing or unavailable target opens the existing form without a start, with Dev selected when no environment is supplied. Set startReview false only for manual selection. Resume an existing job or saved result without another start; recovery never starts a replacement.

functions.name: show_agent_map
functions.description: Show a workflow-free deterministic map of a Copilot Studio agent powered by the GitHub Copilot harness, its configured components, and conservative Skill-to-Tool or Knowledge references.

functions.name: browse_agent_reviews
functions.description: Browse completed Agent Review records in a paginated grid and open an existing persisted review fullscreen.

functions.name: open_agent_debugger
functions.description: Open a read-only debugger for saved Copilot Studio conversations. Pass the agent and, when known, the conversation ID. The inline view has no pickers. Resolve one exact agent in the supplied environment or Copilot Studio Kit - Dev without the target form or full agent catalog. Preserve a supplied conversation ID and load its analysis only if it belongs to that target and date range; otherwise show the list with the reason. With no conversation ID, automatically select and analyze the first authorized saved conversation in the existing most-recent-first list order. Show an empty state when none exist. Keep errors visible. Never start a review.

functions.name: open_evaluation_builder
functions.description: Shows the generated test cases for one Copilot Studio agent. If a generated set exists, it shows that set. Else it generates new cases and saves them as one test set in Copilot Studio. Inline edits sync to Copilot Studio. Pass the exact agent name. The server resolves it in the supplied environment or in Copilot Studio Kit - Dev. Never runs evaluations.

functions.name: get_evaluation_draft
functions.description: Read the complete unchanged temporary draft for this caller. No start, save or evaluation execution.

functions.name: get_evaluation_native_support
functions.description: Check caller-scoped target metadata, case-sensitive native parent binds, existing Conversation templates and harness limits. This is not new-save or grading proof. No write.

functions.name: create_agent_evaluation_set
functions.description: App-only save of one generated Eval Builder draft as one native Conversation test set in Copilot Studio. The app calls it automatically when the generated cases appear. Bound to this caller, target, the generated questions or the user's question edits, the expected responses and the immutable request UUID (the draft ID). General quality does not compare expected answers. One atomic changeset, inner-status checks and complete exact read-back. Never runs evaluations or publishes an agent. An uncertain response requires read-only recovery, not another creation.

functions.name: get_agent_evaluation_save
functions.description: Read-only recovery of an existing immutable native save. Verify all components and parent relationships for the same caller, draft, grant and request UUID. Never sends another changeset, runs an evaluation or publishes.

functions.name: update_agent_evaluation_case
functions.description: App-only inline edit or deletion of one case in a verified saved set for this caller, draft, grant and request UUID. Used by generated sets, which save automatically. Reads back the exact change. Never runs an evaluation or publishes.

functions.name: get_initial_widget_data
functions.description: Read a caller-scoped complete app result or one immutable lossless gzip/base64 chunk. Every serialized reply is at most 65536 bytes. Retain every record and app-only metadata. This recovery cannot start a Review, save or run an evaluation.

functions.name: get_app_view_resource
functions.description: Read a small immutable manifest for one compiled peer view. App-only chunks each stay under 65536 serialized bytes. Reassemble and verify the exact resource hash in the existing app without another host handshake. No target initialization, Review start, save or evaluation execution.

functions.name: get_app_view_chunk
functions.description: Read one immutable lossless base64 resource chunk for an app peer view. The complete serialized tool reply is below 65536 bytes. Reassemble only against the matching manifest hash. No Review, native write, evaluation execution or publication.

functions.name: list_debugger_agents
functions.description: List active classic and generative Copilot Studio agents in one environment for the Agent Debugger interface.

functions.name: list_debugger_conversations
functions.description: List bounded saved conversations for the selected Copilot Studio agent in the Agent Debugger interface.

functions.name: analyze_debugger_conversation
functions.description: Analyze one saved Copilot Studio conversation in the Agent Debugger interface.

functions.name: get_debugger_turn_details
functions.description: Load full activity details for one selected conversation turn in the Agent Debugger interface.

functions.name: get_debugger_child_transcript
functions.description: Load the transcript for one connected-agent session selected in the Agent Debugger interface.

functions.name: get_debugger_conversation_transcript
functions.description: Load complete saved parent-agent conversation JSON on demand. Requires authentication. Limited to 500 transcript records and an 8 MiB response; rejects incomplete exports. Connected-agent transcripts remain separate.

functions.name: list_reviewable_agents
functions.description: List Copilot Studio agents powered by the GitHub Copilot harness in a selected environment. Call after the user selects an environment.

functions.name: get_agent_map
functions.description: Build a workflow-free deterministic map for a selected Copilot Studio agent powered by the GitHub Copilot harness.

functions.name: get_connected_agent_map
functions.description: Load the current components for a connected agent selected inside Agent Map.

functions.name: list_agent_reviews
functions.description: List persisted Agent Review records for a selected source environment.

functions.name: start_agent_review
functions.description: Create an Agent Review job only after the user confirms the selected target with Create in the live Review form. Requires confirmed:true; can consume credits. Preserve its acknowledged job ID on success or partial failure. Never call to open a form or restore progress.

functions.name: get_agent_review_status
functions.description: Get progress for an existing Agent Review job.

functions.name: finalize_agent_review
functions.description: Finalize a completed or salvageable Agent Review job and persist the result.

functions.name: get_agent_review_result
functions.description: Load an existing saved Agent Review by reviewId with its saved Agent Map and complete findings in the Review UI. Use summary for the inline view or fullReview for the expanded view. This read never starts or finalizes a review.
